svg.title: Castaway, side A, listed on a Commodore 64 screen
svg.desc: Side A of the Castaway disk listed on a Commodore 64 screen, light blue characters on dark blue inside a light blue border. LOAD"$",8, SEARCHING FOR $, LOADING, READY. and LIST, then the disk name CASTAWAY with the ID LO-FI in reverse video, and a picture drawn in file names: CAST AWAY in line letters between two block rules, a cloud, a gull and the sun, a palm with drooping fronds and one coconut, a ship on the horizon, her sitting on the sand with headphones and a coconut, the raft and the waves. Then the real entries (92 ACTIVITIES.TOML, the four EVERY timers, 151 MAKE←AUDIO.PY, 26 SCENE LIFE, 0 SERVE.PY), the signature ART BY BOLLARD, 195 BLOCKS FREE. and READY. with a blinking cursor.
